data.one_liner: Complete Flutter toolkit for Brazilian validations, form masks, logging, and cryptography.
data.what_it_does: Provides an aggregated toolkit for Brazilian applications in Flutter, bundling document validations, input formatters and masks, typed results, structured logging, and authenticated cryptography into a single dependency.
use_when: Building a Flutter application that targets Brazilian users and requires document validation or input masks.
Needing multiple ecosystem modules like Brazilian validation rules, masks, structured logging, and cryptography together in a Flutter app.
avoid_when: Building a pure Dart project, as this package adds Flutter to the dependency graph.
Only needing a single independent feature such as a simple email validator or color picker.
strengths: Combines five official ecosystem modules under a single dependency.
Provides built-in input formatters and validation rules for common Brazilian documents and fields.
Preserves historical imports and provides gradual migration paths.
weaknesses: Pulls in multiple bundled dependencies that might be unnecessary if only one feature is needed.
Logger does not remove sensitive data automatically.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the package to your pubspec.yaml dependencies and import it.

alternatives.name: email_validator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need basic email validation instead of a complete Brazilian toolkit.
